Authentic Mexican Food…WOW!!!
Dec 2022 • Family
Authentic Mexican food in Vietnam, is that even possible, how good could it actually be?

Well it’s authentic for sure, right down to the simplest detail of ordering a Corona beer or the large selections of Tequila for you.

No matter what you order, you can’t go wrong. You could close you eyes with every bite, and it will send you to Mexico.
Carnitas was slow cooked to perfection, the guacamole with chips is a MUST!!! I will have dreams about how smooth and delicious that guacamole.

Staff was friendly, the place immaculate, great decor, and plenty of seating.

If you are looking for a break from the local food, or just want to try some of the best Mexican food, then this place is a must on your visit to the city.

reviews.review_text:
Emmaandjim
Auckland Central, New Zealand49 contributions
1
Fab Mexican
Sep 2022 • Couples
Excellent margaritas and White Russian Horchata (50% off in happy hour 5pm to 7.30pm so around 70VND each!). The batter on the shrimp and fish tacos was crunchy, and the salad crisp and fresh. 
I’d choose the standard carnitas over the michoacan version as I’m a bit picky and the fatty bits not to my liking. 
The quesadilla was fantastic and the juiciest I think I’ve ever had 😊
The others enjoyed their carnitas chimichangas too - one was customised to leave out the rice. 
The restaurant was clean and tidy and the best small restaurant bathroom I’ve been to so far.
Will be back next time we’re in HCMC!
Was so keen to eat I forgot to take photos of the food 😂
